letter:
My dearest Liza, my jaan, my forever cutie,  
Every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you.  As the calendar flips—today feels like a quiet celebration of the day we said “I do”—my heart still skips whenever I hear your name.  Your smile lights up the dunes and the streets alike, and I can’t wait to build more memories, hand in hand, wherever our love takes us.
poem:
Across the sand and city lights we roam,  
Your laugh, my compass, always brings me home.  
In monsoon whispers or desert’s golden hue,  
My love, my Liza, forever bound to you.
